title: An embedded C² submanifold is locally the graph of a C² map over its tangent plane (parent steps 2–5)
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C² submanifold of dimension d (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N), let x ∈ N ∩ U, and let ι : ℝ^d → ℝ^P be a linear isometry whose range equals the tangent space tangentSpace N x (as sets). Then there are u : ℝ^d → ℝ^P and reals δ₁, δ₂ > 0 such that: closedBall(x, δ₁ + δ₂) ⊆ U; u(0) = 0; Du(0) = fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0; u is C² on D := ball(0, δ₁); for every v ∈ D, u(v) ⊥ ι(ℝ^d) (⟨ιw, u(v)⟩ = 0 for all w), ‖Du(v)‖ ≤ 1, ‖u(v)‖ < δ₂/2 and x + ιv + u(v) ∈ N; and whenever v ∈ ℝ^d, h ∈ ℝ^P, ‖v‖ < δ₁, ‖h‖ < δ₂, h ⊥ ι(ℝ^d) and x + ιv + h ∈ N, then h = u(v).
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (ι : Euclid d →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → x ∈ N ∩ U → Set.range ι = tangentSpace N x → ∃ (u : Euclid d → Euclid P) (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ), 0 < δ₁ ∧ 0 < δ₂ ∧ closedBall x (δ₁ + δ₂) ⊆ U ∧ u 0 = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u (ball 0 δ₁) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid d) δ₁, (∀ w : Euclid d, inner ℝ (ι w) (u v) = 0) ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ u v‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖u v‖ < δ₂ / 2 ∧ x + ι v + u v ∈ N) ∧ ∀ (v : Euclid d) (h : Euclid P), ‖v‖ < δ₁ → ‖h‖ < δ₂ → (∀ w : Euclid d, inner ℝ (ι w) h = 0) → x + ι v + h ∈ N → h = u v
